title: `getBaseConditions()` can return an unparenthesized top-level `OR`
description: getBaseConditions() returns unparenthesized OR, causing SQL precedence issues when composed into WHERE clauses that make filters silently ignored

title: Three unreachable branches in `getBaseConditions()`
description: authConditions is always truthy, making lines 76-80 unreachable and misleading readers that auth conditions are optional

title: Org and team auth SQL lost all execution coverage
description: Tests assert against hand-written Prisma.sql literals instead of executing against database, losing coverage for org and team authorization scope paths

title: `InsightsBookingServicePublicOptions` drops the discriminant, turning a compile error into silent no-data
description: Constructor type widens scope to bare union and makes teamId optional, losing type-safe discriminated union validation so misconfiguration fails silently
